string.text: Reduces bullet dispersion, which improves accuracy.
Faster twist rate increases muzzle velocity and reduces bullet dispersion.
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
Individual adjustment of the standard parts of the feeding mechanism decreases the probability of malfunctions related to feeding issues.
Reduces the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm. Improves reliability.
Grip panels made of polymer improve handling and slightly reduce overall weight of the firearm.
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Reduces overall weight of the gun by replacing the standard magazine with a lightweight counterpart.
Precise adjustment of the internal parts and reduction of play in the chamber improves accuracy.
Balanced slide decreases muzzle climb and felt recoil.
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their modern light-alloy counterparts.
